crossings.note: Al Kharid / Lumbridge river boundary, and the only crossing on it. Its two Gate locs are decorative -- opening them does nothing. walkTo across x=3268 is client_rejected from every tile tried until the toll dialog below is completed, at which point the same walk succeeds instantly. Confirmed live 2026-09-08. Three details each cost a session: (1) it is a TOLL costing 10 coins -- a character with an empty purse completes the whole dialog and is still refused, with no message saying why, which reads exactly like a hard block; (2) it works only from z=3227 -- all confirmed crossings depart (3264-3267, 3227) and land (3273, 3227), while z=3228 has none, so being one tile off looks like a wall; (3) the crossing hop is 6-9 tiles, longer than walkTo's ~7-8 cap, because it behaves like a dialog-gated teleport -- send ONE direct walkTo to 'beyond' rather than hopping. Because the boundary is a river, a character on the west bank north of z~3240 cannot reach the eastern corridor (x~3269-3277) by walking east at its own latitude; it is walking into water and reports 'moving but not closing on the target'. Go south to z=3227, cross, then north.

Lumbridge/Varrock. The southern world and the Varrock area are separate regions in this file's own recorded history: everything walked in the north was walked by a character that was already there, so for a long time no route existed between them and route.py correctly reported no_known_route. This is the crossing that links them, found by route.py --explore probing the narrowest unwalked gaps between the two regions. It is a plain walk -- no gate, door, stile or dialog -- which is why nothing in the world announces it and why only exploring found it. Confirmed live 2026-09-09. This is also, independently, the far edge of the swamp/marsh band two characters got stuck in from 2026-09-08 through 2026-09-10 approaching from the south -- the crossing sits just past where those attempts gave up: the swamp itself wasn't the route, this specific gap north of it was.

confirmed_paths.note: Draynor-area farm boundary back to Lumbridge courtyard. Clean both times run (2026-09-08, 2026-09-10), no obstacles. Reliable escape route: get to (3207,3276) first, then this leg is safe.

Lumbridge courtyard east through a building cluster to the Lumbridge Church (Altar, Pray-at, at ~3243,3215 -- see lumbridge_church landmark) and out into open woods beyond. Clean, all doors already open. Confirmed 2026-09-10. No `hops` recorded here -- this leg was walked with manual scan-then-walk calls rather than travel.py, so the exact intermediate tiles weren't logged precisely enough to trust as graph edges. Worth re-walking with travel.py once to capture real hops.

From the woods east of the church, working generally northwest through open forest, reaches x~3235 z~3286. Not fully clean: needed a couple of sidesteps and one Gate. Confirmed 2026-09-10. Short of the actual Lumbridge/Varrock crossing (departs 3219,3333) -- the link between this leg and that crossing hasn't been walked yet.

open_problems.note: This journey's own target was never actually reached this way -- the real route (see confirmed_paths) goes through the documented crossing at (3219,3333) instead. Kept here anyway: every hop above is a real recorded movement route.py's graph can use, and the obstacles_crossed list (several real Gates in this area) is useful data in its own right, not just a record of failure.
